newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer sees upturn soon in aluminum futures.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer sees upturn soon in aluminum futures.

text.p: Just as the copper futures market overstated copper fundamentals for more than a year and a half, the aluminum futures market is currently understating the positive fundamentals of aluminum, New York brokerage Oppenheimer and Co Inc said in an equities report.

"In sum, the visible inventory, pricing and speculative elements of the futures markets, in our opinion, have disguised the underlying positive fundamental elements of the global aluminum industry," Oppenheimer said.
"We believe these elements will surface before year end and be a sustainable and positive force for aluminum for a couple of years," the brokerage continued.
Oppenheimer rated stock at Alcan, Alcoa, Alumax, and Reynolds Metals all buys.

Third quarter earnings per share were scaled back, however, because demand was rising, but at a slow rate, and due to a poorer mix of shipments as producers sell more lower priced primary metal rather than value added fabricated products, to cut inventories.
A sustained drop in LME aluminum stocks would be the catalyst for change from destocking to restocking.
